seo_title: How to Prepare for Your Food Tour | Simply Enak
seo_description: Everything you need to know before your Simply Enak food tour. What to wear, what to bring, dietary requirements, and what to expect.
hero_title: Getting Ready for Your Food Tour
hero_description: A few simple tips to make sure you get the most out of your Malaysian food adventure.

whatToWear.title: Light, breathable clothing
whatToWear.description: Malaysia is hot and humid year-round. Cotton, linen, or moisture-wicking fabrics are ideal.

whatToWear.title: Comfortable closed-toe shoes
whatToWear.description: We walk about 2 km on city streets and market floors. Supportive walking shoes make a big difference.

whatToWear.title: Umbrella or foldable raincoat
whatToWear.description: Tropical showers can appear suddenly. Most tours continue in light rain under covered walkways.

whatToWear.title: Sun protection
whatToWear.description: Hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen recommended for daytime tours.

whatToWear.title: Camera or phone
whatToWear.description: You'll want to capture the colorful market scenes, sizzling woks, and beautiful temple architecture.

whatToBring.item: Small appetite - we'll be eating 10-18 tastings!
Cash (MYR) if you want to buy extras from vendors
Any dietary requirements clearly noted on your booking

dietaryNotes.title: Dietary Requirements
dietaryNotes.description: We accommodate most dietary needs with advance notice: vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, Jain, and most allergies. Let us know when booking and we'll prepare alternatives at every stop.

whatToExpect.title: Pacing
whatToExpect.description: We walk at a relaxed pace with frequent stops. No need to rush.

whatToExpect.title: Group Size
whatToExpect.description: Max 9 people per guide. Small groups mean personal attention.

whatToExpect.title: Food Volume
whatToExpect.description: Enough for a full meal. Come hungry but not starving.

whatToExpect.title: Hygiene
whatToExpect.description: We only visit vendors we personally trust. Hand sanitizer is available.
